data_source: Binance Vision USD-M 5-minute metrics (topLongShortPositionRatio, count_long_short_ratio) and 5-minute klines, SHA-256 verified
estimands: On 2024 training dates per symbol, fit (1) class-tagged ARX recursion n_{c,t} = alpha_c + r_c n_{c,t-1} + w_c ret_t for top-trader and all-account classes and map to 30-minute post-shock return predictor, and (2) price-only two-exponential kernel fitted to 12 lags of 5-minute returns and signed taker flow
evaluation: On 2025-2026 test dates, across all top-decile 5-minute signed flow shocks (|q_t| >= 90th percentile of symbol training |q_t|), forecast the cumulative 30-minute post-shock price response Delta p_{t+1:t+6}
primary: Out-of-sample R^2 gain of the class-tagged memory forecast over the price-only memory forecast is positive (Delta R^2 > 0), with one-sided Clark-West p < 0.05 and 2,000-draw date-block bootstrap 95% CI above 0
study: Paper 1 Section 8.3: Out-of-sample predictive test of class-tagged memory estimates vs price-only memory estimates
